column2: If the District Secretary/ Government Agent or Medical Officer is of the view that it is required to add chlorine to
any tank, wells, water holes or reservoir situated in the camp area or it is required to be closed for prevention of
diseases, the District Secretary/ Government Agent or Medical Officer shall have the power to do so.
